text: ＊は　＊の　つかいかたを　きれいに　わすれた！

structure.jp: きれいに　わすれた！

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた added to a verb stem means 'the way of doing it'. つかいかた = 'how to use'.

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.span: きれいに　わすれた
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word like きれい makes it tell how the action is done. きれいに わすれた = 'forgot cleanly, completely'.
